app.title: Soundscape Annotation Atelier
app.subtitle: Annotation tool for soundscape, field recording and electroacoustic composition.

import.title: Import annotation
import.subtitle: Select a JSON v1.0 file exported from this app or compatible with the soundscape-audio-analysis toolkit. You will need to re-load the original audio file separately.
import.audioPrompt: Load the original audio file now to complete the import.
import.invalidSchema: Invalid schema: the JSON must have schemaVersion, audio, annotations fields.

welcome.title: Start by loading an audio file
welcome.subtitle: Drop an audio file above, or use the header button. Guaranteed formats: WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG. For .m4a files from iPhone Voice Memos, if decoding fails, convert to WAV with cloudconvert.com.
features: Controlled vocabulary: Schaeffer, Smalley, Schafer, Krause, Chion
Time markers with drag and resize on the waveform
JSON export compatible with the soundscape-audio-analysis toolkit
Local persistence with IndexedDB, no server upload
Bilingual IT/EN, installable as a PWA
